note: Round ADDIN (R301, Q044). The IM code each neighbourhood is known by in the file names of each job, one table per job, since the letters name other areas in the two jobs: the Native IMA holds 02 and 01A, the Parsons site models of Revit All Zones name IMA and IMB Zone 1. The area of a plot is always its Neighbourhood_ID and Construction_Zone of the Rev 9 DLUS (R256), never an IM letter, so this file only names files. Every row is measured: the plots a file of that job holds, keyed by the area key, with the file, its kind (model or schedule), the count and where the count was measured. No row is guessed. native comes from the Round 17 coverage (R267): key plots of the location plan unit plots of each neighbourhood. parsons holds the 7 Parsons site models of Round ADDIN, each counted on its Revit 2024 key copy in Phase 2b by key_join.py (R326): the plots its links name whose generic floor has at least cadLinks.cutShareMin (0.9, R120) of its area on one baseplan face, by the area key of that face, beside the IMC and IMD schedules of DATA-5. Round 17 counted the IMC key 337 of 337 by plot number, the join by area share counts 324, since 12 plots have no face that holds 0.9 of their generic floor (cut, the plots of R120 among them) and 2441 has no generic floor. The four rows DATA-5 guessed by the letter order and removed in Phase 0b, IMA 021, IMB 022, IME 02 and IMF 03, are what the keys hold by measurement.
